prompt: Create a high-fidelity north-star desktop web application UI comp for ITERUM, a professional graphic designer’s campaign-direction workspace. Landscape 16:10, straight-on product interface screenshot, no device frame, no people, not a landing page. Three functional zones: campaign brief/control bank at left, a very large visual moodboard work surface in the center, and review tray/activity dock at right. Visual world: CREATOR HARDWARE BENCH, a precise studio instrument with bone and putty keycap grays, a gunmetal chassis, charcoal legends, one safety-orange commit action, knurled aluminum zoom/grouping knob, and a compact amber status screen. Build the interface from strict whole-key grid units with one satisfying asymmetry; tactile controls must clarify the workflow, not overwhelm it. Real product content: ITERUM; STATIC BLOOM; “The air remembers.”; ozone, crushed iris, mineral rain, warm concrete, skin. Central work surface contains sophisticated visual references: wet concrete under sodium light, crushed flower in clear resin, asymmetric typographic poster, color palette strip, and editable type specimen; three references are visibly LOCKED. Right review dock contains 3 agent-found proposals with source, rights status, rationale, Reject and Approve. The focal moment is the single safety-orange APPROVE key committing the active proposal to the board while the amber screen reports “PLACED · RECEIPT 014 · UNDO”. Show clear canvas zoom and territory controls through one knurled knob and a few labeled keys. No keyboard-shaped gimmick covering the whole screen, no generic dashboard cards, no chatbot, no sci-fi glow, no gradients, no fake metrics. Dense but calm professional creative-tool UI, exact typography, accessible contrast, believable control states, full production-grade craft.
